checks.evidence: Export is local, deterministic, copy-only and mechanically scoped.
Profile and request use closed JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 objects.
Bundle identity and manifest use canonical logical content and exact byte identities.
Traversal, source-root escape, symlink and repository-contained destination are denied.
Raw formats, credentials, private absolute paths and non-UTF8 compact records are denied.
Per-file and total capacity are checked before copying.
Manifest is written last and staging is atomically renamed or quarantined.
Identical bundles reuse only after full byte verification; collisions block.
No network, subprocess, repository write, remote write, provider, R2, publication or market authority exists.
Focused, retained and complete repository checks have not yet run on the final PR head.

rollback: Disable the export profile and preserve all accepted bundles and manifests.
